displayPattern: PCBHR104 unitary diagnostic display in Goodman service manual RS6200007 r27 (ASXC, DSXC, GSXC condensing units and ASZC, DSZC, GSZC heat pumps). Digit 3 is blank. Digit 2 is 0 and digit 1 is 7. The code is 07
meaning: Open run circuit. The compressor and outdoor fan are off, and both pressure switches are closed.
causes: Compressor not wired to the control
diySteps: Write down 07. It is the open run circuit, not the start-circuit code 06 and not lockout L7
Technician: check the compressor and the wiring. The chart says the fault clears after 1 normal cycle, or by cycling 24 VAC to the control
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. An open run winding is compressor diagnosis, not a homeowner reset.
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
